title: OS command execution via IO.popen (ruby) — review required
description: The ruby sink IO.popen launches processes. Untrusted input in the command becomes command injection. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms arguments are trusted or passed as vectors via Open3 with an args list.
remediation: Use Open3 with an args list with separate arguments, never interpolated command strings.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any IO.popen call matches.
